structural_findings: The paper's central contribution — the conflict-free bank/offset mapping — is a reconstructed XOR-fold, not the source's actual scheme, so the headline architectural feature is reproduced only by analogy.
The 20%/33%-reducing radix-4 schedule (the second key contribution) is absent: the implemented butterfly uses the naive 3-mult datapath, so the optimization the reference is named for is not present.

Crossbar permutation, twiddle-ROM rearranged-loop addressing, and 9-cycle pipeline are not modeled — the verified artifact is the NTT algebra, not the CFNTT datapath/schedule that distinguishes this system.

summary: Reproducibility is solid on the numeric core (q, N, psi/omega/Ninv, Barrett constants, negacyclic flavor are all pinned and both impls agree), but the spec leaves the paper's signature structures — the conflict-free bank/offset map, crossbar permutation, twiddle-ROM addressing, and an internally contradictory radix-4 mult count and FSM — to guesswork, so the impls converge functionally yet reconstruct rather than transcribe those pieces. The biggest fidelity gap is that the two defining CFNTT contributions are not faithfully reproduced: the conflict-free mapping is an invented XOR-fold and the 33%/20% optimized radix-4 schedule is replaced by a naive 3-mult butterfly, leaving a correct generic negacyclic NTT rather than the specific accelerator.
guessed: Conflict-free bank map -> XOR-fold of the four 3-bit groups of i: bank(i)=(i&7)^((i>>3)&7)^((i>>6)&7)^((i>>9)&7), offset(i)=i>>3 (spec offers this as a reproduction choice; the paper's actual map is not transcribed)

NTT engine -> standard merged-negacyclic Cooley-Tukey forward + Gentleman-Sande inverse pair with a bit-reversed psi-power twiddle table (Longa-Naehrig style); the asserted 'natural-order output / no bit-reversal' is a hardware-ordering property I reproduce only functionally (internal bit-reversed intermediate, undone by the GS inverse)

Radix-4 modular-multiply count -> implemented the 3-fetched-twiddle datapath (W1=w, W2=w^2, W3=w^3) given by config_radix_selector/r4_fuse/exploded view; the metadata op-count reconciliation instead claims 'optimized 2 mults' (internal spec contradiction)
Per-stage crossbar permutation sigma_s -> not modeled; only the bank/offset map and distinctness property reproduced
Small-N twiddle roots -> derived as psi^(2048/(2n)) from PSI=1945 to keep verification on the real modulus
Barrett correction bound -> proved r<3q (it is actually <2q for this mu); spec stated '<=2 subtractions'
FSM -> used the schedule_controller transition table; the top-level 'DONE' state is not wired into any listed transition, so DRAIN->IDLE is treated as terminal-loop
radix4 j-rotator -> j = psi^512 (order 4, j^2==-1), per spec; sign/rotation convention taken from the spec's explicit y0..y3 equations
Negacyclic NTT algorithm -> merged Cooley-Tukey forward (DIT) + Gentleman-Sande inverse with psi^bitrev10(k) twiddles (Longa-Naehrig style), consistent with spec's table_fwd T[k]=psi^bitrev_10(k)
Radix-2 butterfly -> u=x0, v=w*x1, y0=(u+v) mod q, y1=(u-v) mod q (authoritative in config_radix_selector.spec)
Radix-4 butterfly add/sub tree -> y0=x0+b'+c'+d', y1=x0+jb'-c'-jd', y2=x0-b'+c'-d', y3=x0-jb'-c'+jd' (authoritative; verified == two radix-2 stages)
Conflict-free bank function -> bank(i)=(i&7)^((i>>3)&7)^((i>>6)&7)^((i>>9)&7), offset(i)=i>>3 (authoritative in crossbar.spec)
DIT pairing convention for the conflict-free check -> butterfly low index has the stage stride bit(s) clear (no add-carry), so operands differ in exactly the stride bit(s)
Barrett -> qh=(x*mu)>>28, r=x-qh*q, <=2 conditional subtractions, input bounded x<q^2 (authoritative params mu=21843,k=28)

Pipeline depth (9 cyc), crossbar sigma_s routing table, exact ROM f(stage,block) addressing, and the radix-4 stage-fusion schedule are NOT functionally modeled (timing/routing decoration), only the butterfly algebra + bank distinctness are verified
